events.title: 오하이오주 포인트플레전트에서 태어나다
events.description_en: He was born in Point Pleasant, Ohio, in the United States.

events.title: 웨스트포인트를 졸업하다
events.description_en: He graduated from the United States Military Academy at West Point.
events.place_name_en: West Point, New York, United States

events.title: 멕시코 전쟁에서 싸우다
events.title_en: He fought in the Mexican-American War
events.description: 멕시코 전쟁에 참전해 여러 전투를 치렀다. 이 경험이 훗날 남북전쟁 지휘의 밑거름이 되었다.
events.description_en: He served in the Mexican-American War and fought in several battles. The experience became the foundation for his command in the Civil War.

events.title: 줄리아 덴트와 결혼하다
events.description: 오랜 연애 끝에 줄리아 덴트와 결혼했다. 부부는 평생 서로에게 의지했다.
events.description_en: After a long courtship he married Julia Dent. The two leaned on each other for the rest of their lives.

events.title: 군을 떠나 사업에 거듭 실패하다
events.title_en: He left the army and failed at business after business
events.description: 군을 떠나 농사와 여러 사업을 벌였으나 하나같이 실패했다. 아버지의 가죽 가게에서 점원으로 일하며 어렵게 생계를 이었다.
events.description_en: He left the army and tried farming and several ventures, all of which failed. He scraped by working as a clerk in his father's leather goods store.

events.title: 남북전쟁이 터지자 다시 군에 서다
events.title_en: He returned to the army when the Civil War broke out
events.description: 남북전쟁이 시작되자 일리노이 지원병 연대의 대령으로 군에 복귀했다.
events.description_en: When the Civil War began, he returned to the army as colonel of an Illinois volunteer regiment.

events.title: 도넬슨 요새에서 무조건 항복을 받아내다
events.title_en: He forced unconditional surrender at Fort Donelson
events.description: 테네시의 도넬슨 요새를 공격해 무조건 항복을 받아냈다. 북군의 첫 큰 승리였다.
events.description_en: He attacked Fort Donelson in Tennessee and forced an unconditional surrender. It was the Union's first major victory.

events.title: 빅스버그를 함락시키다
events.description: 오랜 포위 끝에 빅스버그를 함락시켜 미시시피강을 따라 남부연합을 둘로 갈랐다.
events.description_en: After a long siege he captured Vicksburg, splitting the Confederacy in two along the Mississippi River.

events.title: 북군 전체를 지휘하는 중장이 되다
events.title_en: He was promoted lieutenant general over all Union armies
events.description: 링컨에게서 중장 계급을 받아 북군 전체를 지휘하게 되었다.
events.description_en: Lincoln promoted him to lieutenant general, giving him command of all Union armies.

events.title: 애퍼매턱스에서 리의 항복을 받다
events.title_en: He accepted Lee's surrender at Appomattox
events.description: 버지니아 곳곳에서 리의 군대를 몰아붙인 끝에 애퍼매턱스 코트하우스에서 항복을 받아냈다. 남북전쟁의 사실상 끝이었다.
events.description_en: After pursuing Lee's army across Virginia, he accepted its surrender at Appomattox Court House. It marked the effective end of the Civil War.
events.place_name_en: Appomattox Court House, Virginia, United States

events.title: 대통령으로 재건 시대를 이끌다
events.description: 제18대 대통령에 취임해 두 임기를 지냈다. 남부에서 활개 치던 KKK를 법으로 억누르며 해방노예의 권리를 지키려 했다.
events.description_en: He was inaugurated as the 18th president and served two terms. He used federal law to suppress the Ku Klux Klan in the South and worked to protect the rights of freed slaves.

events.title: 회고록을 마치고 죽다
events.title_en: He died shortly after finishing his memoirs
events.description: 목 부위의 암에 걸려 죽어 가면서도 가족의 생계를 위해 회고록을 써 내려갔다. 원고를 마친 지 며칠 뒤 뉴욕 마운트맥그리거에서 죽었다.
events.description_en: Dying of throat cancer, he pushed through his memoirs to secure his family's future. He finished the manuscript and died days later at Mount McGregor, New York.
events.place_name_en: Mount McGregor, New York, United States
